```{r}
#| include: false
hub_name <- apt_names[[hd$hub]]
n_flights <- sum(hd$cover$N)
eur_share <- mean(hd$tm$TA_CLASS == "EUR-EUR")
intl_share <- mean(hd$tm$TA_CLASS == "INTL-INTL")
cl <- chain_links(hd$ch)
prm <- setNames(hd$params$MEDIAN, hd$params$PARAM)
cap <- \(x) paste0(hd$hub, ": ", x)
```

### `r hd$hub` – `r hub_name`

`r format(n_flights, big.mark = ",")` hub flights and `r format(nrow(hd$tm), big.mark = ",")` arrivals in the study period. `r pct(eur_share)` of the turnarounds are intra-European (EUR–EUR) and `r pct(intl_share)` international (INTL–INTL). Proxy parameters: $B_{\text{in}}$ = `r prm[["B_in"]]` min, $B_{\text{out}}$ = `r prm[["B_out"]]` min, $T_{\text{in}}$ = `r round(prm[["T_in"]], 1)` min.

